Thermal Corridor.name: Thermal Corridor
Thermal Corridor.description: The user beats slow strokes at a building entrance or street corner, sending feather-seeded currents through half a block for the rest of the scene. The draft pulls smoke and gas out through upper windows and lifts up to a dozen fleeing people at a time in long, cushioned bounds over rubble to safety. It reaches half a pure wind user's lift, and the user must stay grounded and beating to hold the corridor open. Strain: severe.
